name: qikki-reminders
description: Qikki — Lightweight minimalist reminder scheduler with weekly & monthly recurrence, synthesized sounds, and custom vibration patterns.
author: Qikki

scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:sync-repo && npm run build && npm install --no-save electron@^35.0.0 electron-builder@^26.0.12 && npx electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run desktop:sync-repo && npm run build && npm install --no-save electron@^35.0.0 electron-builder@^26.0.12 && npx electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:msstore: npm run desktop:sync-repo && npm run build && npm install --no-save electron@^35.0.0 electron-builder@^26.0.12 && npx electron-builder --win appx --x64
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run desktop:sync-repo && npm run build && npm install --no-save electron@^35.0.0 electron-builder@^26.0.12 && npx electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal
scripts.desktop:mac:mas: npm run desktop:sync-repo && npm run build && npm install --no-save electron@^35.0.0 electron-builder@^26.0.12 && npx electron-builder --mac mas --universal
scripts.desktop:release:mac: npm run desktop:sync-repo && npm run build && npm install --no-save electron@^35.0.0 electron-builder@^26.0.12 && npx electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish always
scripts.desktop:release:win: npm run desktop:sync-repo && npm run build && npm install --no-save electron@^35.0.0 electron-builder@^26.0.12 && npx electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish always
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
